    Indicator cocycles on zero products (Section 11) #

    lem:two-associative-tables, prop:indicator-cocycles and the associativity part of prop:zero-product-family, for A₀ = kP.

    The correction ε(r, s) = r * s on pairs with rs = 0 (and 0 otherwise) is the difference of the stem product (associative, Prop 8.12) and the ray product. The identity dε = 0 of the proof of Lemma 11.1 is proved here in the monoid with zero M P, case by case on the table of that proof; nested insertions vanish by Cor 8.11.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
